correctness.rationale: Maximal families are classified into n full stars and C(n,3) edge triangles. All eight labelings of each intersecting triple arise by explicit concepts, whereas four-edge intersecting sets cannot realize a 3-of-4 trace. The coefficient formula and VC dimension follow. The positive-branch count for any second query is at most two, yielding Ldim <=3 and VC lower bound Ldim >=3. The nerve-lemma argument and triangular-face attachments give simple connectivity of the 2-skeleton and its Euler/Hurewicz wedge rank. Standard-library exhaustive checking confirms n=4..8 supports and n=4..7 homology; not used as general proof.

value.rationale: The input is the natural membership learning class of all maximal intersecting uniform-2 edge families. A canonical line-graph 2-skeleton describes every shatterable query set, not just the largest one; the complete f-polynomial and uniform online-learning dimension hold in arbitrary ambient sizes. The same complex has a computable nontrivial homotopy type. This connects three mathematical viewpoints and establishes a reusable exact example, not a random finite slice. The known full clique-complex topology is not claimed as a new theorem.
